clue.text: A fellow with business essentially in scribbling?

definitions.text: A fellow with business essentially in scribbling?

parts.note: a fellow is a man

indicators.note: scribbling suggests the letters are scrawled into a new order
the essence of the word is its core, so the outer letters of business are dropped

explanation.surface: A man whose work is all about scribbling down words.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: a literary assistant is indeed a man whose trade is writing. 'essentially' and 'in scribbling' are the two operations.
explanation.definitionFit: A secretary who takes dictation or copies manuscripts is literally a fellow whose job is writing things down.

clue.text: Favourite showing skirt and leg

parts.note: a mini is a short skirt
on is the leg side in cricket

explanation.surface: A favourite person shows off a short skirt and a leg.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side of the field is also called the on side.
explanation.definitionFit: A favoured underling or a ruler's pet servant was historically called by this term.

clue.text: Language without appeal inhibiting two kings

indicators.note: inhibiting means holding in, so one piece is enclosed within the others

parts.note: sans is French-derived for without
it means sex appeal
K is the chess abbreviation for king and R stands for rex, Latin king

explanation.surface: A language lacking charm keeps two monarchs in check.
explanation.definitionFit: This ancient classical tongue of India is the liturgical language of Hinduism.

clue.text: Behave unco-operatively with drama over?

parts.note: a play is a drama
up means over or finished, as in time is up

explanation.surface: Being difficult when the theatrics are finished.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for misbehaving or being troublesome, used of children or a faulty machine.

clue.text: What might be shot at home for news segment

parts.note: a bullet is something fired from a gun
in means at home

explanation.surface: Something fired off in the house becomes a piece of news coverage.
explanation.definitionFit: A short broadcast or printed report of the latest news is called by this word.

clue.text: Power associated with a document of approval

parts.note: vis is Latin for force or power

explanation.surface: Authority is linked to a document granting approval.
explanation.definitionFit: An endorsement in a passport permitting entry to a country is an official approval document.

clue.text: Difficult situation facing continent French abandoned — and island

parts.note: a jam is a tight spot

indicators.note: abandoned means left out, so those letters are dropped from the continent

parts.note: Africa is a continent

explanation.surface: A tricky situation arises when the French leave a continent and an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A Caribbean nation that occupies a single large island south of Cuba.

clue.text: Gardener scribbled handy couple of notes for one of contrasting character?

parts.note: Gertrude Jekyll was a famous English garden designer

indicators.note: scribbled suggests the word handy is written out messily into a new order

parts.note: D and E are two musical notes

explanation.surface: A gardener jots down a handy pair of notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Stevenson's tale of a man with a good and an evil self gives the name for a split personality.

clue.text: Ill-mannered unionist in group is facing hospital

indicators.note: in puts the single letter inside the word for group

parts.note: a lot is a group or batch

explanation.surface: A rude trade union member in a group is up before a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarse and boorish behaviour like a yob's is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Holy women need cultivated fruit

indicators.note: cultivated means worked or grown, so the letters are tilled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Nuns need fruit that has been grown.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale green-fleshed variety of melon is a sweet fruit.

clue.text: Philosopher mostly followed by society captured by neat artist

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Kant is the German philosopher

indicators.note: captured by means held inside the word for neat

parts.note: dinky means neat and small

explanation.surface: A thinker's thoughts, followed by a society held by a tidy painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Wassily, the Russian pioneer of abstract painting, was a celebrated modern artist.

clue.text: Get to know a service introduced by the French

parts.note: le is French for the
RN is the Royal Navy, an armed service

explanation.surface: Finding out about a service brought in by the French.
explanation.definitionFit: To acquire knowledge or find out is to come to know something.

clue.text: Right I cut for extended rest

indicators.note: I cuts into the word, splitting it open

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: I am right to cut back for a long rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Staying in bed later than usual in the morning is a long rest.

clue.text: Type ruled irregular in common opinion

indicators.note: irregular signals the letters of type ruled are out of order

explanation.surface: Typing on lined paper is said to be uneven.
explanation.definitionFit: Something supposed by general belief is said to be so according to what people say.

clue.text: Unattractive feature in toast?

parts.note: the toast chin-chin is a chin said twice, hence a doubled chin, an unflattering fold of flesh

explanation.surface: Something unsightly turns up in a piece of toast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'toast' looks like grilled bread but is the drinking toast chin-chin.
explanation.definitionFit: A fold of fat below the jaw is an unattractive facial feature.

clue.text: A man on board, we hear, making attack

indicators.note: we hear signals the words are judged by how they are said

parts.note: a salt is a sailor, a man on board ship

explanation.surface: Talk of a sailor makes an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: A physical attack on a person is a violent onslaught.

clue.text: Grant, perhaps, given by academic body is not disputed

parts.note: uni is short for university

indicators.note: disputed means argued over, so is not is jumbled

explanation.surface: A grant from a university is beyond argument.
explanation.walkthrough: Grant is Ulysses S Grant, the Union general in the American Civil War, not money for study.
explanation.definitionFit: Grant led the Northern side in the Civil War, so he exemplifies a supporter of the Union.

clue.text: Condemn source of smoke right away around old city

indicators.note: around means the shortened vessel goes round the city
away means removed, so the letter for right goes

parts.note: a censer is a vessel for burning incense
Ur is an ancient Mesopotamian city

explanation.surface: Denouncing a smoking thing as it is moved away from an ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' takes R from CENSER, leaving CENSE.
explanation.definitionFit: To condemn is to criticise severely or officially reprimand.

clue.text: Pleasing quality seen possibly in shares

indicators.note: in puts the jumbled letters inside the word for shares

parts.note: cuts are shares, as in a cut of the profits

indicators.note: possibly says seen could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A charming trait might be found in stocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Being charming or attractive in a sweet way is a pleasing quality.

clue.text: Son with arrogance seen in force is a rebel

indicators.note: seen in places these letters within the word for force

parts.note: dint means force, as in by dint of
side means airs or arrogance, as in putting on side

explanation.surface: An arrogant son using force is a rebel.
explanation.definitionFit: A dissenter who opposes official policy, especially in an authoritarian state, is a rebel.

clue.text: Engineer showing sign of doubt with fellow in general on reflection

indicators.note: in places the letters inside the turned general
on reflection means mirrored, so the general's name is read backwards

parts.note: Robert E Lee was the Confederate general
if expresses doubt or condition

explanation.surface: An engineer shows doubt alongside a fellow inside an army commander, looking back.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustave, the French engineer, designed the famous Paris tower bearing his name.

clue.text: Set of beliefs enshrined in rabbi's lamentation

indicators.note: enshrined in means kept within, so the answer sits inside the words

explanation.surface: A faith is preserved in a rabbi's mourning.
explanation.definitionFit: The Muslim religion is a system of faith and beliefs.

clue.text: Undiminished interest before part of play

parts.note: int is the abbreviation for interest
an act is a division of a play

explanation.surface: Interest is undiminished before part of a performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Something whole and undamaged has lost nothing, so it is undiminished.

clue.text: Submissive followers missing sun in foreign country

indicators.note: missing means lacking, so the letter for sun is removed

parts.note: yes-men are sycophantic followers

explanation.surface: Servile followers without sunshine in another land.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation at the southern tip of the Arabian Peninsula is a country abroad.

clue.text: Master with musical company brought up play without words

indicators.note: brought up in a down clue means written upwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: EMI is a well-known record company

explanation.surface: A master and a music firm stage a silent drama.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting out a story with gestures alone is a performance with no speech.

clue.text: A Latin cafe endlessly excited and impassioned

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters are mixed
endlessly means without its final letter

explanation.surface: An endless Latin cafe gets everyone fired up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' trims cafe to CAF before 'excited' shuffles it with A LATIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Zealous and obsessive enthusiasm is impassioned devotion.

clue.text: New service in middle of week in a body

indicators.note: in puts these letters inside the central pair
the middle of the word week is its two central letters

parts.note: mass is a church service

explanation.surface: A new church service in midweek.
explanation.definitionFit: A French phrase meaning all together, as a whole group.

clue.text: Class of people, one performing in part

parts.note: a sect is a group of people with shared beliefs
I is the Roman numeral one
on means performing, as an actor on stage

explanation.surface: A group with one person performing in part.
explanation.definitionFit: A segment or division of something larger is a part.
